sections.0.items.0.text:
在海裡待了短短幾十分鐘，
卻經歷了完全不同的世界。

Just minutes in the sea,
and a whole new world.
sections.0.items.1.text:
綠芙是一家老字號 PADI 認證的潛水中心。沒潛過的人從體驗潛水開始；
想考照的人，3 天 2 夜就能拿到 OW 初級證照，安心又方便。

The Reef is a long-established PADI dive center. Never dived? Start with Discover Scuba.
Want to get certified? Earn your Open Water card in 3 days, 2 nights, easy and worry-free.
sections.1.items.1.text: 岸潛（較深）SHORE DIVE　·　最深 18 m
sections.1.items.3.text: 3 天 2 夜，給自己一個認識新世界的機會。
3 days, 2 nights: your chance to meet a whole new world.
sections.1.items.4.text:
第 1 天 8:00–17:00｜平靜水域 2 支＋開放水域 1 支
第 2 天 8:00–17:00｜開放水域 3 支，結業

Day 2  8:00–17:00 | 3 open water dives, course complete

sections.2.items.3.text:
給已有初級證照的海洋『初癮』者（不限協會）。
讓自己成為頂尖中性浮力、水中導航、夜潛和電腦錶使用、方位辨別的好手。

For certified divers who are already hooked (any agency).
Become great at neutral buoyancy, underwater navigation, night diving, dive computers and orientation.

sections.4.items.1.spans.0.t:
・有心臟病、高血壓、糖尿病、癲癇、氣喘、肺部疾病、耳鼻喉問題、
    近期動過手術或懷孕，不建議潛水，或需先經醫師評估。

・Heart or lung disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, epilepsy, asthma, ear/nose/throat problems,
    recent surgery or pregnancy: diving isn't advised, or get a doctor's clearance first.
sections.4.items.1.spans.1.t: 報名時會請你填 PADI 健康問卷。
You'll be asked to fill in the PADI medical questionnaire when you book.
sections.4.items.1.spans.2.t:
・潛水後至少間隔 12–18 小時再搭飛機。
・潛水前 8–12 小時不喝酒；前一晚睡飽，感冒鼻塞請改期。
・天候或海況不佳時，教練會以安全為優先調整或取消，
    退款方式請見

・Wait at least 12–18 hours after diving before flying.
・No alcohol 8–12 hours before diving; sleep well, and reschedule if you have a cold.
・If the weather or sea is rough, instructors will adjust or cancel for safety.
